questions.title: Q2: State Newton's first law in one line.
Q3: Difference between mass and weight (2 points).

answers: An object stays at rest or in uniform motion unless an external force acts on it.
Mass is the amount of matter; weight is the force of gravity on that mass.
वस्तु अपनी अवस्था में तब तक रहती है जब तक बाहरी बल न लगे।
द्रव्यमान पदार्थ की मात्रा है, भार गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल है।
